you can find some of the best glutenfree restaurants in hamburg! for example AEndre (Lehmweg 31a) - they have delicious salads and a really good hummus which you have to try. Another restaurant is Grilly Idol (Clemens-Schultz-Straße 40) - their burgers are the pure heaven! go out and taste it!
